title: 第3章 被抓

content_zh:
具体情况云画也不太清楚。
大致就是，因为已经故去的爷爷，当年救了齐子衡的爷爷，两家才会定下婚约，婚书都有呢，但一直没有对外宣称罢了，毕竟这年头不流行这个。
初二开学时，得到了这个消息的云画，简直激动得快要跳起来！
那可是齐子衡学长啊，是她写满了好几本日记的齐子衡学长！
他英俊帅气、才华横溢，他是那么优雅矜贵、高不可攀，而且他人还特别好！是他把她从羞窘无助和嘲笑中拯救出来，是他给了她第一份尊重！
云画做梦都没想到，有一天，她竟然能够成为齐子衡学长的未婚妻！
她一定是上辈子拯救了宇宙！
上辈子听到这个消息的她，简直快乐得要飞起来了。她一门心思地想要坐实这个消息，让所与人都知道，她才是齐子衡的未婚妻，有婚约的未婚妻哦！比女朋友更高级的未婚妻！
小女孩都有虚荣心，她做梦都在想象，当这个消息传播开来的时候，学校里会有多少女人用羡慕嫉妒的目光看她。
可她真不敢想那么多，就算有婚约，可齐子衡学长不认她也没办法呀。现在齐子衡学长给她了这么个考验，只要她能通过，他就认她这个女朋友，这对云画来说，简直梦寐以求。
然而完全沉浸在恋爱幻想中的女孩子，已经连思考能力都没有了。
云画微微叹息。
上辈子也是，就和今天一样，她手机上忽然有人给她发信息，对方声称自己是齐子衡。当初年幼且不知人性险恶的她，哪里会想到有人会冒充齐子衡给她下套呢！
对方发来消息，要考验她是不是个懦弱的胆小鬼，要看她是不是真的有勇气，看她够不够资格当他齐子衡的女朋友！
考验就是，晚自习第一节课下课，去学校桃林那边见面，他要送给她一个礼物。
信息中还说，要是她不敢来的话那就算了，他会让爷爷解除婚约的，当然，会补偿给云家一些钱。
一门心思都在齐子衡身上的云画，根本没想过这是不是激将法，是不是陷阱，就一口答应了。
南溪中学晚自习是两节课。
当年第一节课下课，云画出了教室后，绕开人群，偷偷去了桃林。
可等待她的，不是曾经拯救过她让她芳心独系的白马王子，而是……一盆冷水！

那是在刚走进桃林没多远，前面又树枝拦住了路，她不得不绕路，绕路的那边桃树重的很密，她走着总是会碰到桃树枝干。
怕被别人发现，也想快点过去的她，在黑暗中撞上了前面的一棵桃树。
“哗啦！”
桃树上面不知道被谁放了一盆冷水，桃枝被她这么一撞，冷水瞬间浇下，从头到尾，透心凉！
夏天的衣服本就单薄，一盆水从头浇下，足以把她浇得湿透。
那天不是周一和周五不用穿校服，云画穿的也是普通的短袖，湿透了之后，整个人十分狼狈。
还好今天月亮不太好，昏暗中估计也看不出来。
一身狼狈的云画，怕齐子衡来，又怕他不来，暗恋少女纠结挣扎到了极点。

content_en:
Yun Hua didn't know the specific situation.
Roughly speaking, it was because of the late grandfather who saved Qi Ziheng's grandfather that the two families entered into a marriage contract. There was a marriage certificate, but they never announced it to the outside world. After all, it was not popular these days.
When the second grade of junior high school started, Yun Hua got the news and was so excited that he almost jumped up!
That was Senior Qi Ziheng, the Senior Qi Ziheng whom she had filled several diaries with!
He is handsome, talented, elegant, dignified and unattainable, and he is also very nice! It was he who saved her from embarrassment and ridicule, and it was he who gave her the first respect!
Yun Hua never dreamed that one day, she would become senior Qi Ziheng's fiancée!
She must have saved the universe in her previous life!
When she heard the news in her previous life, she was so happy that she almost flew up. She wholeheartedly wanted to confirm the news and let everyone know that she was Qi Ziheng's fiancée, her engaged fiancée! A fiancée who is more advanced than a girlfriend!
The little girl has vanity, and she dreams about how many women in the school will look at her with envy when the news spreads.
But she really didn't dare to think that much. Even if there was an engagement, there was nothing she could do if Senior Qi Ziheng didn't recognize her. Now senior Qi Ziheng has given her such a test. As long as she can pass it, he will recognize her as his girlfriend. This is a dream for Yun Hua.
However, girls who are completely immersed in love fantasies no longer even have the ability to think.
Yun Hua sighed slightly.
It was the same in her last life. Just like today, someone suddenly sent her a message on her mobile phone. The other person claimed to be Qi Ziheng. When she was young and unaware of the dangers of human nature, how could she have imagined that someone would impersonate Qi Ziheng and set a trap for her!
The other party sent a message to test whether she was a coward, to see if she really had the courage, to see if she was qualified to be his girlfriend Qi Ziheng!
The test is that after the first class of evening self-study, go to the school to meet her at Taolin, and he will give her a gift.
The message also said that if she didn't dare to come, forget it, he would ask her grandfather to terminate the engagement, and of course, he would compensate the Yun family with some money.
Yun Hua, who was focused on Qi Ziheng, didn't even think about whether this was a way to provoke the general or whether it was a trap, so he agreed immediately.
Evening self-study in Nanxi Middle School consists of two classes.
After the first class that year, Yun Hua left the classroom, bypassed the crowd, and secretly went to Taolin.
But what awaits her is not the Prince Charming who once saved her and made her heart alone, but... a basin of cold water!
Not far into the peach forest, there were branches blocking the way in front of her, so she had to take a detour. The peach trees on the side of the detour were very dense, and she would always bump into peach branches as she walked.
Afraid of being discovered by others and wanting to get there quickly, she bumped into a peach tree in front of her in the dark.
"Wow!"
Someone put a basin of cold water on the peach tree. She hit the peach branch like this, and the cold water poured down instantly. It was chilling from beginning to end!
Her summer clothes were already thin, so pouring a basin of water over her head was enough to get her soaked.
That day was not Monday or Friday, so Yun Hua was also wearing ordinary short-sleeved clothes. After getting soaked, he was in a very embarrassed state.
Fortunately, the moon is not very good today, so I probably can’t see it in the darkness.
Yun Hua, who was in a state of embarrassment, was afraid that Qi Ziheng would come, but also afraid that he wouldn't come. The girl he had a crush on was struggling to the extreme.
If you like the goddess of academic tyranny, she’s so awesome. Please give her a thumbs up.
